rules: Tradable at the time: price C$0.05+ and 20,000+ shares a day. Costs: one price step + 0.5%.

findings.title: After a 10%+ up day
findings.question: Do big up days keep going, or fade?
findings.note: Bought at the next morning's open. 'vs avg' = compared with the average stock in the same price band that day.

findings.title: After a 10%+ down day
findings.question: Do big drops bounce back, or keep falling?
findings.note: Bought at the next morning's open, which removes most of the fake 'bounce' from closing prices.

findings.title: Volume spike on an up day
findings.question: Up 3%+ on 3x normal volume: is buying behind the move a good sign?

findings.title: Volume spike on a down day
findings.question: Down 3%+ on 3x normal volume: is heavy selling a warning?

findings.title: What predicts the next month?
findings.question: Every month, stocks are split into five equal groups by each measure; this is how each group did over the following 20 trading days.
rows: Past 6 months, skipping the last month
findings.note: Average 20-day return per group, bought at the next open, before costs. Stocks that later stopped trading stay in.

findings.title: Does the market's trend matter?
findings.question: Average 20-day return of a tradable TSX Venture stock, depending on whether the TSX Venture index was in an uptrend.
findings.note: Bought at the next open, before costs.

findings.title: Best and worst months
findings.question: Typical (median) TSX Venture stock's return in each calendar month, averaged over the years.
findings.note: Few years per month, so only strong, repeated effects mean much (e.g. December tax-loss selling).

findings.title: Day of the week
findings.question: Average one-day move of a tradable stock, by weekday (close to close).
findings.note: Strength above 3 or below -3 would be worth a look; smaller is noise.

findings.title: Sectors right now
findings.question: Median stock in each group (sorted from company names, so it's approximate).
findings.note: 'Move together' is how alike the stocks' daily moves are: near 0 = each on its own news, 0.4+ = they trade as a group.
